_source: RampNet docs/data_provenance.md section 1 and stage_one/crop_model/ps_model/data/download_data.py (RampNet 7f0167c0): the Project Sidewalk servers the crop model's training labels came from, mapped to city_id through the /v3/api/cities url field; visibility checked against the live listing on 2026-11-19 (all public). Round-3 splits read from the CurbRamp and SurfaceProblem split.csv on klone.
summary: RampNet stage two trained on open-government curb-ramp locations in three cities that are not Project Sidewalk deployments, with keypoints placed by a crop model. That crop model trained on Project Sidewalk CurbRamp labels (Agree - Disagree >= 2) from the 12 deployments below, every one of them in round 3's train, val and test splits (one of them in val for CurbRamp only); none of round 3's three held-out deployments is among them.
